newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends higher snaps losing streak.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends higher snaps losing streak.

text.p: The UK's leading share index snapped out of a six-day losing streak on Tuesday as bid speculation, coupled with a solid rebound on Wall Street, lifted sentiment, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 index closed 20.5 points higher at 4,596.3, after shedding 207 points during the previous six sessions.
Yet, today's advance was not broad-based, with FTSE 100 advancers narrowly outpacing decliners 52 to 45.
